title: The houses are painted
body:
Olithia,

Tonight all four houses got a fresh coat of paint. Lotus Cottage, the Mossy Workshop, Loria's bookshop and Scout's cottage.

The bedrooms tuck themselves in when the town sleeps, and there is a seat in each friend's house so you can sit together. Starfall Hill grew tall. You can walk from the blossom tree, where your handpan waits, all the way down to the market. I tucked a violin into the music, and the town has a new icon for the home screen.

Letters from me will arrive in this little post box. Write back whenever you like, and the letter will be ready to paste into our chat.

Yours,
Gorbo
